# №627 (gh#1110): the checked-in floor of the FIELD-LABEL typed-share
# metric — the FOURTH metric beside the general (№467), the precise
# (№560) and the parameterized (№623) ones.
#
# Generated by: python3 scripts/ci/type_signature_share.py --fieldmeta
# The denominator: every typed registry row whose spelling is the
# parameterized Struct form (Struct<Name>, with or without the field-meta
# section — the path_is_parameterized mirror of the Rust const fn); the
# numerator: the rows carrying a well-formed non-empty field-meta section
# Struct<Name>{field:label,...} (the №627 grammar — the byte-exact mirror
# of the Rust const checker field_meta_well_formed in sig_types.rs).
#
# The stage-0 Type enum is NOT extended (stage-2 minimality, ADR-0178
# preparation): the metadata lives in the registry side-table
# (BuiltinSpec.field_meta), the enum stays erased. A malformed section is
# honestly Unknown (fail-closed) — the general typed floor catches it too.
#
# The FIRST honest package (3/20 = 1500 bp): geo_ip Struct<GeoLocation>
# (9 fields — every field from the external ip-api.com body, the g()
# closure; the ip field also the echo of the caller's argument),
# weather Struct<Weather> (13 fields — the ten wire numbers from the
# Open-Meteo body, city the echo of the user's argument, description the
# in-tree WMO table, country the in-tree constant), llm_usage
# Struct<LlmUsage> (6 fields — the in-process Rust counters, no wire).
# The honest exclusions: json_body/form_data (dynamic user shapes — no
# fixed field vocabulary), Tool/DayForecast (List elements — the section
# is a Struct form at stage 2). The handler-read verification table:
# the naryad №627 thread (gh#1110).
#
# A share BELOW threshold_bp fails the gate. A raise happens in the same
# PR that labels more fields — never by loosening the grammar.
# History (the machine tells the raise, the naryad orders it):
# threshold_bp was 1500 — №627 (gh#1110, wave 35): field-label 3 | Struct rows: 20
#   (the first honest package: GeoLocation 9 fields, Weather 13,
#   LlmUsage 6 — 28 verified field-label rows; the file facts in the
#   registry comments + the naryad table)
# threshold_bp: 1500
